name: Final Fantasy, Black Mages Legacy
overview: The children of Vivi Ornitier—Mel, Koln, Luciola, Théa, Fala, and Doc—are the last black mages in the four continents. Living in the city of Alexandria, the children live a peaceful life, until, one day, Koln discovers Mel frozen like a statue—could the tragic legacy of their father be finally catching up to them?
